content.title: JPMorgan Deepens Retirement Push With Trump Accounts Match And WealthOS Deal
content.summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) plans to match U.S. government contributions to new Trump Accounts for eligible employees' children, alongside Bank of America. The Trump Accounts are part of a federal retirement savings initiative aimed at long term family financial security in the United States. JPMorgan has completed the acquisition of WealthOS, a UK based pensions technology company, to expand its retirement planning capabilities. content.title: Senator Made 73% On Nvidia Stock, But Investors Missed Out As Disclosure Missed Deadlines
content.summary: Senator Katie Britt (R-Ala.) recently disclosed numerous transactions that all occurred in the months of April 2025 and November 2025, according to the Benzinga Government Trades page. With the dates listed being in April 2025 and Nov. 7, 2025, these trades are likely violations of the Stock Act, according to well-known congressional trading trackers on social media. PelosiTracker tweeted that Britt disclosed a purchase of JPMorgan (NYSE:JPM) stock while she sat on the Senate Banking committee.

content.title: JPM starts Barrick Mining at Overweight, flags valuation gap versus Agnico Eagle
